title: NEMA stepper motor face-mount dimensions
standard: NEMA ICS 16, Part 4 (motion/position control motors — frame and mounting dimensions). The standard is written in inches; the inch value is carried beside each converted millimetre value.
corroborating_datasheet: Oriental Motor PKP Series stepping motors, dimensional drawings for the 20/28/35/42/56 mm frames.
notes: The frame number is the flange width in tenths of an inch (17 = 1.7 in).
The mounting holes form a SQUARE. bolt_circle_mm = bolt_square_mm * sqrt(2) and is given only for polar patterning.
flange_mm is the standard's maximum across the flats; individual motors measure a little under it. Never size a pocket to flange_mm alone.
pilot_boss_height_mm is vendor-typical, not fixed by ICS 16 — confirm on the datasheet before making a blind recess depend on it.
shaft_d_mm is the single-shaft nominal. NEMA 23 is 1/4 in (6.35 mm) nominal but 8 mm variants are common; always confirm.
face_tap_depth_mm is the usable thread depth in the motor face — screw length = plate thickness + 4 to 5 mm, never more.

bracket_rules.clearance_class: ISO 273 medium (ASME B18.2.8 normal) unless the pattern must locate the part.
